public.title: MediLink ku bigo by'ubuvuzi
public.problem: Abarwayi bamara amasaha ku mirongo kandi bagatwara impapuro zabo bava ku kigo bajya ku kindi. MediLink iha ikigo cyawe gufata gahunda kuri interineti, umurongo ugaragara, amadosiye y'ikoranabuhanga n'ubwishingizi muri sisitemu imwe, mu Kinyarwanda, Icyongereza n'Igifaransa.
public.sessionEnded: Ubusabe bwawe bwabitswe. Twakoherereje link yo kubukomeza nyuma.

admin.title: Abayobozi b'ikigo
admin.body: Shyiraho serivisi, gahunda n'konti z'abakozi, ukurikirane imikorere y'ikigo.

reception.title: Kwakira abarwayi
reception.body: Andika abaje, uyobore umurongo, wandike ubwishyu n'ubwishingizi.

doctor.title: Abaganga n'abaforomo
doctor.body: Reba abarwayi b'uyu munsi n'amateka yabo, wandike isuzuma n'imiti.

pharmacy.title: Farumasi
pharmacy.body: Akira impapuro z'imiti z'ikoranabuhanga, wandike imiti yatanzwe.

apply.title: Gusaba
apply.body: Tubwire ibijyanye n'ikigo, wohereze uruhushya n'impapuro zo kwiyandikisha.

verify.title: Kugenzura
verify.body: Itsinda ryacu rigenzura inyandiko kandi rishobora gusaba impinduka.

setup.title: Gutegura
setup.body: Umuyobozi wawe ashyiraho serivisi, gahunda n'abakozi.

live.title: Gutangira
live.body: Abarwayi barakubona kandi bagafata gahunda kuri interineti.

cost.a: Kwiyandikisha ni ubuntu mu gihe cy'igerageza. Ifatabuguzi ryose rizumvikanwaho nawe mbere y'uko ritangira.

documents.a: Uruhushya rwa Minisiteri y'Ubuzima. Ibigo byigenga bikenera kandi icyemezo cya RDB na TIN.

time.a: Akenshi iminsi mike y'akazi nyuma yo kohereza ubusabe bwuzuye.

data.q: Ni nde ushobora kubona amakuru y'abarwayi bacu?
data.a: Abakozi bawe gusa n'abarwayi ubwabo. Amakuru aguma mu Rwanda kandi buri gusura kurandikwa.

start.title: Andikisha ikigo cyawe
start.intro: Tangira n'amakuru make. Ushobora kubika ugakomeza nyuma: tukoherereza link kuri imeyili.
start.emailHint: Link yo gukomeza ubusabe tuyohereza kuri iyi meyili.

resume.title: Komeza ubusabe bwawe
resume.invalid: Iyi link ntikora cyangwa yarashaje. Saba indi hasi.
resume.linkBody: Andika imeyili wakoresheje usaba. Niba hari ubusabe butarangiye, tukoherereza link yo kubukomeza.
resume.linkSent: Niba hari ubusabe butarangiye kuri iyi meyili, link iri mu nzira. Reba imeyili yawe.

submitted.title: Ubusabe bwoherejwe
submitted.sessionOver: Ubusabe bwawe bwoherejwe. Tuzakwandikira ku bikurikiraho.
submitted.next1: Tugenzura inyandiko zawe, akenshi mu minsi mike y'akazi.
submitted.next2: Niba hari ikibura, tukoherereza link yo gukosora.
submitted.next3: Nibwemerwa, tuzatumira umuyobozi w'ikigo cyawe gutegura MediLink.

wizard.title: Ubusabe bwo kwiyandikisha
wizard.sessionOver: Igihe cyawe kuri ubu busabe cyarangiye. Saba link nshya kugira ngo ukomeze.

save.conflict: Ubu busabe bwahinduwe ahandi. Twafunguye verisiyo iheruka; reba impinduka yawe iheruka.

location.outsideRwanda: Aho hantu hari hanze y'u Rwanda. Ongera ugerageze uri ku kigo, cyangwa usimbuke iyi ntambwe.
location.geoDenied: Ntitwashoboye kubona aho uri. Ushobora gusimbuka iyi ntambwe.
location.geoUnavailable: Mushakisha yawe ntishobora gutanga aho uri. Ushobora gusimbuka iyi ntambwe.

documents.intro: Ohereza amafoto agaragara neza cyangwa PDF. Buri dosiye igenzurwamo virusi mbere y'uko itsinda ryacu riyifungura.
documents.chooseOwnership: Hitamo nyir'ikigo ku ntambwe y'Ikigo kugira ngo ubone inyandiko zikenewe.
documents.numberRequired: Ongeraho nimero n'itariki rurangiriraho, hanyuma wongere wohereze uruhushya.
documents.insurersHint: Si ngombwa. Ongeraho amasezerano ya buri kigo niba uyafite.

upload.hint: PDF, JPEG, PNG cyangwa HEIC, kugeza kuri MB 10.
upload.wrongType: Ohereza dosiye ya PDF, JPEG, PNG cyangwa HEIC.

admin.intro: Ni nde uzayobora MediLink ku kigo? Tuzamutumira ikigo nikimara kwemerwa.
admin.name: Amazina y'umuyobozi

review.terms: Nemera amabwiriza yo gukoresha MediLink ku bigo.
review.dpa: Nemera amasezerano yo gutunganya amakuru mu izina ry'ikigo.
review.ncsa: Nemeza ko ikigo cyiyandikishije muri NCSA nk'ugenzura amakuru, cyangwa kizabikora mbere yo gutangira.

documents.moh_licence: uruhushya rwa MINISANTE rufite nimero n'itariki
